Hi Alice — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide the artifacts and a short narrative that maps to each SIG question. High-level answers below; attaching the detailed artifacts and a sanitized rotation log in a follow-up message once I confirm a couple of redaction items with engineering.

- In transit: All public endpoints use TLS 1.2 minimum; TLS 1.3 enabled by default. We support a modern cipher suite set (AES-GCM / CHACHA20_POLY1305) and require TLS for all client-server traffic. For Redwood Private (VPC / on-prem) we support mutual TLS for control-plane connections and optional mTLS for customer-managed connections.

- At rest: Customer data at rest is encrypted using envelope encryption. Data encryption keys (DEKs) are AES-256-GCM. DEKs are encrypted (wrapped) by a key encryption key (KEK) managed in a KMS/HSM. Raw plaintext keys are never persisted in clear anywhere in the service.

- KMS/HSM architecture: For our hosted offering we use cloud KMS providers (AWS KMS / Google KMS depending on region) for KEK management. For Dedicated and Private deployments we offer customer-managed keys (CMKs) and can integrate with CloudHSM or on-prem HSMs (FIPS 140-2 level 3/4 certified devices where applicable). Root key generation for tenant-level CMKs occurs inside an HSM-backed KMS when customers opt into BYOK/CMK.

- Rotation policy: DEKs are rotated automatically during rekey operations tied to job windows (default: DEKs rekey on object re-write or every 90 days). KEK/master key rotation is supported and by default scheduled annually; customers on Dedicated/Private can set a shorter rotation cadence. We maintain key versioning and a key state machine (active/retired/destroyed).

- Audit artifacts: We can provide a sanitized rotation audit log showing key-version changes and KMS events (no customer payloads). Also attaching our KMS policy PDF and the HSM topology diagram in the next message.

If that summary looks good I'll send the sanitized rotation log + the artifacts and an annotated mapping to the SIG controls (easy to drop into the SIG matrix). If you want a 30-min call to walk through, I'm available Tue/Thu next week.
